[LSER.9.2.3] Series absorb a sample from a fact of a hydration target
([LHYD.4.1.7]) only when its `corr` slot is empty. Live asserts and the
persisted-sample re-asserts used for series rebuild carry an
empty `corr` and absorb normally. Facts loaded for
rule matching via `hydrate_*` carry a **non-empty**
`corr` and are **skipped** by the series absorber, so
a retrospective hydration does not pollute a live window. The
runtime enforces this with a `(corr "")` guard on the
absorber path for hydration targets (see [LHYD.10.4]
and the reference-runtime lowering RLOW.8.4). The engine does not
surface a separate "hydration done" signal.
